layers.name: Smoke
layers.what: Fine smoke (PM2.5) at the surface, as a computer model works it out.
layers.colours: By NEA's 4 bands: Normal sage, Elevated amber, High dark orange, Very high brown.
layers.numbers: Yes: tap, or ask your AI
layers.credit: Generated using Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information 2026

layers.name: Wind
layers.what: Wind 10 m above the ground. It shows where the smoke is going.
layers.colours: White lines moving with the wind on Real Earth; grey blue on Plain. Faster and brighter where stronger.
layers.numbers: Yes: tap, or ask your AI

layers.name: Fires
layers.credit: Fires: NASA FIRMS (LANCE, ESDIS), VIIRS near real-time
layers.what: Heat seen from space, 375 m across, in the last 24 hours.

layers.name: Monitors
layers.credit: Monitors worldwide via OpenAQ, licence per location
layers.what: Fine smoke, PM2.5, from government monitors and community sensors, each at its place.
layers.colours: Dots by NEA's 4 bands: sage Normal, amber Elevated, dark orange High, brown Very high. Rings: DOE's 24-hour index, by the smoke it stands for.
layers.numbers: Yes: tap, or ask your AI

layers.name: Satellites
layers.what: Where the satellites that take these pictures are now, and where they passed in the last 50 minutes.
layers.colours: White, with dotted white trails for the last 50 minutes.

layers.name: Real Earth
layers.what: The planet as NOAA-20, Suomi NPP and NOAA-21 saw it the day before: clouds, deserts and the haze itself. Blue Marble where none saw anything.
layers.updates: Once a day, the day before

layers.name: Smoke from space
layers.what: How much light the smoke and dust in the air block, seen from above by 3 satellites over 3 days. No colour where cloud hid the ground.
layers.colours: Pale yellow (a little), orange, dark red (a lot), as NASA draws it; clear where there is little.
layers.updates: Once a day, the day before
layers.satellite: NOAA-20, Suomi NPP, NOAA-21, VIIRS Deep Blue

layers.name: Carbon monoxide
layers.what: A gas from burning, about 5 km up, from 6 days of passes.
layers.colours: Pale yellow (a little), orange, red, purple (a lot), as NASA draws it; clear where there is little.
layers.updates: Once a day, the day before
